what: Prints photos and video as accent-colored square dots — each cell’s brightness is cut by an 8×8 Bayer threshold to switch the dot on or off, and as the cursor nears the photo box (within 420px, square of the remaining distance ratio) the cells shrink continuously from 7px to 3.5px so the same picture gets denser (12% of the remaining gap per frame). As cells shrink, base brightness .52→.34 · top-to-bottom fade .68→.9 · edge darkness .1→0 change together, and dots barely over the threshold (.14 or less) are drawn in a half-brightness color. A dot is half the cell size
ease: Approaches 12% of the remaining gap each frame

options.near: Cell size over a photo (px), default 3.5
options.range: Starts getting denser once the cursor is within this distance (px), default 420
options.smooth: Share of the distance closed each frame, default .12 — 0 means instant
options.--fx-dither-dim: Color of dots that barely cross the threshold, default accent color halfway toward the background

note: Photos (img·video) are data-fx-part="src" When set this way it is hidden and shown only as a canvas. Video is recaptured every frame while playing. Touch devices have no cursor, so once it is on screen it is set to the dense cells (near)

from.where: index.js portrait() — dot portrait in the panel before Contact (.ac-pt__frame). Cell size, Bayer, contrast and blur values of the original PortraitStage
